description: A base image bump has to cut a release, or it never becomes an image anyone pulls.

release-please moves the version on fix and feat and on nothing else, and Renovate defaults to chore. So a patched Alpine lands on main, release-please declines to release, the image job is skipped on its release_created gate, and nothing is published.
Every job stays green throughout, which is what makes it worth a rule: it does not look like a failure, it looks like a quiet afternoon.
Tooling stays chore, deliberately. biome, commitlint and lefthook are not in the image, so bumping one should not tag a release and republish a byte-identical container.
This is Renovate's default. It is written down so a change to that default cannot quietly start cutting releases here.
